explanation: This component is non-zero only at D1, and only when the previous trial was an a2 choice that reached S2 and was rewarded; it is mainly active early in the episode (trials 1-15, sometimes up to about 30, rarely later), where the first one or two such rewards after an unrewarded or a1 trial give 8-10 and each further consecutive reward drops it (about 10, 8, 5, 3, 1). It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at D1 after an unrewarded trial, after a rewarded trial that reached S1 (whether by a1 or a rare a2), and after about trial 30 even when a2 reached S2 and was rewarded.
